name: Explain_6
short_caption: The robot briefly raises its left hand with slightly open fingers to emphasize a point before returning to a neutral pose.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral standing posture facing forward. It then lifts its left hand up to chest height with an open, slightly cupped palm pointing slightly inward, while its head tilts subtly toward the left. It holds this explanatory hand posture briefly before lowering its left arm back down to its side, returning to the neutral starting position.
